meta.method: Chance of leaving: a walk-forward model of where each player is next season, trained on every earlier season's box scores (from 2014), recent seasons weighted more. Moves are inferred, not the official transfer portal: the same ESPN athlete on another team's box score next season is an inferred transfer; no box-score line next season covers graduation, the pros, a lower division, injury or not playing. The portal's public lists carry 247Sports ratings we may not republish. No class history exists in the data (only this season's rosters carry a class), so experience is the number of earlier seasons with a box-score line; no NIL, coaching or eligibility data. Football box scores never list offensive linemen, so they have no estimate. Targets rank likely transfers by their chance of joining the team: availability x a model of which teams transfers join (team and conference strength, his production x the team's strength, the team's expected departures); shown where that model beat availability alone.
